set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Properties cover nonnegativity, mass/marginals, finiteness, and objective decomposition.
- Metamorphic tests cover permutations, valid role swaps, scaling, offsets, and initialization.
- Adversarial tests cover tiny epsilon, extreme penalties, concentrated weights, duplicates, and ill scaling.
- Every accelerated/fallback/precision/approximate/optional path is exercised.
- Seeds and absolute-plus-relative tolerance rationales are explicit.
set.title: Build the solver invariant and metamorphic regression suite
